original_record.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** The King of Braves GaoGaiGar  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `gutsy-robot-command`

**Proposed robots:** GaoGaiGar; HyoRyu; EnRyu; FuuRyu; RaiRyu; Volfogg.

**Source edition:** 1997 television-series base robot designs: GaoGaiGar, HyoRyu, EnRyu, FuuRyu, RaiRyu, and Volfogg. No FINAL redesigns or combined support-robot forms.

**Naming:** Use the six source robot identities. GaoGaiGar is one complete machine; do not also roster its components. HyoRyu, EnRyu, FuuRyu, and RaiRyu stay separate from their combined forms.

**Backstory:** GGG deploys a champion and two vehicle robots, then reinforces the formation with wind, thunder, and reconnaissance. Six machines answer the call; every pair and trio has a permanent assignment.

**Purchasing personality:** FuuRyu joins to support EnRyu in the second pair. RaiRyu and Volfogg complete the reinforcement trio. Investment follows both formations rather than treating GaoGaiGar as a lone Paragon.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **GaoGaiGar** | GaoGaiGar | Opening | Close-combat lead | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 2 | **HyoRyu** | HyoRyu | Opening | Precision support | `single` | balanced / 20% | Deadeye |
| 3 | **EnRyu** | EnRyu | Opening | Mid-range assault | `single` | offensive / 15% | Versatile |
| 4 | **FuuRyu** | FuuRyu | Growth #1 | Protected reinforcement | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 20% | Warden |
| 5 | **RaiRyu** | RaiRyu | Growth #2 | Heavy mid-range fire | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 6 | **Volfogg** | Volfogg | Growth #3 | Close flanker | `single` | offensive / 15% | Sprinter |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | melee | War Club (₡84,000) | Heavy Hammer (₡478,000) |
| 2 | long | Beam Pistol (₡93,000) | Particle Lance (₡425,000) |
| 3 | mid | Bolt Carbine (₡93,000) | Nova Caster (₡425,000) |
| 4 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 5 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 6 | melee | Practice Sword (₡50,000) | Vibro Mace (₡425,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡270,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡208,000; all six at stage 1 ₡2,995,000; 7 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡100,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **GaoGaiGar** | Main Heavy Hammer: Hone Hydraulic Systems 8→10 → Main Heavy Hammer: Augment Armor Plating +3 (new) → Main Heavy Hammer: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Heavy Hammer: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 2 | **HyoRyu** | Main Particle Lance: Hone Targeting Systems 8→10 → Main Particle Lance: Augment Weapon Control +3 (new) → Main Particle Lance: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Particle Lance: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 3 | **EnRyu** | Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 4 | **FuuRyu** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 5 | **RaiRyu** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 6 | **Volfogg** | Main Vibro Mace: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Vibro Mace: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡5,540,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡8,535,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Preserve the complete television GaoGaiGar design, lion chest, crest, and source palette. Use an original two-handed arena hammer; it is not the Goldion Hammer or another robot. |
| 2 | Blue HyoRyu vehicle-robot form with source head and body construction. One long-range arena weapon; do not depict ChoRyuJin or add freezing mechanics. |
| 3 | Red EnRyu individual robot form and correct source equipment silhouette. One mid-range weapon; preserve the source body rather than a combined or alternate vehicle form. |
| 4 | Green FuuRyu individual robot form, preserving source torso and limbs. One short-range weapon and an original arena shield; wind powers provide no additional engine effect. |
| 5 | Yellow RaiRyu individual robot form and source proportions. One heavy mid-range arena weapon; do not depict GekiRyuJin or grant a separate electrical attack. |
| 6 | Base purple Volfogg robot form with recognizable stealth-police styling. One melee arena weapon; no Big Volfogg components, extra figures, or transformation mechanic. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Brave Resolve** | 1 GaoGaiGar + 2 HyoRyu | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Wind and Fire** | 3 EnRyu + 4 FuuRyu | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Shadow Thunder** | 5 RaiRyu + 6 Volfogg | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **GGG Vanguard** | 1 GaoGaiGar + 2 HyoRyu + 3 EnRyu | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Brave Reinforcements** | 4 FuuRyu + 5 RaiRyu + 6 Volfogg | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [official television machine index](https://www.gaogaigar.net/TV/mecha/index.html), [official HyoRyu and EnRyu reference](https://www.gaogaigar.net/TV/mecha/10.html), [official FuuRyu and RaiRyu reference](https://www.gaogaigar.net/TV/mecha/11.html), [licensed television designs](https://www.b-ch.com/titles/499/).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
